jd:
About Us

We’re one of Canada’s largest pension investors, with CAD$320.6 billion of net assets as of March 31, 2026.

We invest funds for the pension plans of the federal public service, the Canadian Forces, the Royal Canadian Mounted Police and the Reserve Force. Headquartered in Ottawa, PSP Investments has its principal business office in Montréal and offices in New York, London and Hong Kong.

Capturing and leading complex global investments requires us to work as one to seize valuable opportunities, in close collaboration with some of the world’s top companies. At PSP Investments, you’ll join a team of motivated and engaged professionals, dedicated to propelling our organization further than ever before.

About The Team

As a Developer Intern within the GenAI & Digital Workplace team, you will join a dynamic and innovative group that leverages its intellectual leadership to create an engaging, efficient, and intuitive work environment. In this role you will play a key role in maximizing the value delivered by the Technology, Data, and Operations (TDO) group to PSP’s various business lines.

Our mission is to enable PSP employees to enhance their digital dexterity, deepen their knowledge of GenAI, and facilitate the secure adoption of AI and collaborative technologies in a constantly evolving technological landscape, while ensuring access to knowledge resources and collaboration channels anytime, anywhere, with contextual relevance.

As a member of the team, you will contribute to our vision of a human-centered and efficient digital experience that helps our business partners invest with foresight, operate with excellence, and foster deeper technological integration. We are a curious team that stays continuously up to date on advanced AI and digital technologies, proactively identifying opportunities for efficiency gains, synergies, and operational benefits, and contributing to PSP’s skills-development strategy and the evolution of our AI and collaboration ecosystem.

About Your Role

As an Intern, GenAI and Digital Workplace, you’ll:



- Help design and document AI Playbooks, practical guides that help PSP teams get more value out of our GenAI tools
- Build small, hands-on AI solutions, such as Microsoft 365 Copilot agents and Claude Skills, that the team can pilot and deploy across PSP's business lines
- Help turn the ideas generated during our internal hackathon into a structured, prioritized backlog the team can build from
- Support testing, documentation, and light troubleshooting of AI prototypes before they're handed off for wider deployment
- Research emerging GenAI tools and capabilities, and summarize practical takeaways and recommendations for the team
- Help track and report on adoption of the AI tools you help build, for example simple usage metrics or user feedback

PSP offers globally aligned compensation structures for its internship program, which are sensitive to local market conditions.

What You’ll Need



- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field
- Must return to studies after the internship, or the internship must be part of your academic curriculum
- Working proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript)
- Genuine curiosity about generative AI and large language models, hands-on experience with AI assistants, prompting, or agent-building (personal, academic, or professional projects all count)
- Comfort with MS Office / Microsoft 365; exposure to the Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) is an asset
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and ask good questions
- Good written and verbal communication skills
- Candidates must have the right to work in Canada* for the period specified to be considered for this position. No support to obtain the right to work will be provided.

- *Options include Canadian citizenship, permanent residency or a valid open work permit
- Bilingualism: English and French (frequent interactions in English with PSP employees based in our offices in Hong Kong, London and New York, and interactions in French with employees in our local offices in Montreal and Ottawa) 

At PSP Investments, we aim to provide a workplace where everyone feels valued, safe, respected and empowered to grow. As part of this leadership commitment, we strongly encourage applications from all qualified applicants and strive to offer an inclusive and accessible candidate experience. If you require any accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, please let us know. 

To apply, please upload your resume, cover letter and most recent unofficial transcript.

Deadline to apply:

Visit us on www.investpsp.com/en/

Follow us on LinkedIn

Job Description

Why GM Financial? 

GM Financial is the wholly owned captive finance subsidiary of General Motors and is headquartered in Fort Worth, U.S. We are a global provider of auto finance solutions, with operations in North America, South America, and the Asia Pacific region. Through our long-standing relationships with auto dealers, we offer attractive retail financing and lease programs to meet the needs of each customer. We also offer commercial lending products to dealers to help them finance and grow their businesses.

Our Purpose: We pioneer the innovations that move and connect people to what matters.

Responsibilities

About the Role

Are you excited about innovation, entrepreneurship and solving complex business problems? Then we are looking for you! Gain hands-on experience in data engineering by supporting code debugging, troubleshooting, and solution development to improve system performance and reliability. This role collaborates with team members through peer code reviews and technical problem-solving while building knowledge of emerging technologies, system operations, and the latest technology releases.

In This Role You Will



- Debugging computer code to correct errors and improve performance
- Problem solving and solution creation
- Participating in peer code reviews to improve the quality of code written by team members
- Proactively learning about new technologies
- Regular communication and troubleshooting with team members
- Reviewing documentation about the latest technology releases and project updates to ensure understanding of system operations 

Qualifications

What makes you an ideal candidate?



- Strong written and verbal communication skills required. This incumbent will be required to give presentations and communicate with business leaders. 
- Strong analytical, quantitative, problem solving, and conceptual skills required. 
- 1-2 years of experience with programming languages (Java/C++/Python) preferred
- 1-2 years of experience with Version Control Systems (GitHub, VSA, SVN) preferred
- Must be detail oriented and able to prioritize tasks to meet deadlines. 
- Must be able to work independently or in a team setting. 
- Previous internships are considered a plus. 

AI Skills Preferred



- Experience with AI assisted software development or automation
- Knowledge of prompting techniques to improve output quality
- Awareness of emerging GenAI capabilities and limitations 

Experience & Education



- Must be a current student pursuing a bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited college or university in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Statistics with at least one semester remaining upon start of the internship. 
- Must possess a minimum of a 3.0 (out of a 4-point scale) overall GPA. 
- Junior or Senior classification preferred. 

Our program offers 



- 11 weeks of work experience (May 26 - August 6, 2027)
- Executive and peer networking opportunities 
- Independent and team project experiences 
- Philanthropic activities 
- Career development 
- Opportunity to apply for full-time career positions 

Our Culture: Our team members define and shape our culture — an environment that welcomes innovative ideas, fosters integrity, and creates a sense of community and belonging. Here we do more than work — we thrive.

Compensation: Competitive pay

Work Life Balance: Flexible hybrid work environment, 3-days a week in office

About Us   

 AON3D is a venture capital-backed, Montréal-based additive manufacturing hardware, software, and materials company. Our solutions drive innovation for hundreds of businesses in 25+ countries worldwide, ranging from small businesses to multinational Fortune 500 corporations.   

 Our mission is to create intelligent tools that automate and optimize the additive manufacturing process, enabling anyone to manufacture high performance parts, in any material, with the touch of a button. 

 About The Role   

 AON3D is looking for a Software Developer Intern to join our team for the Winter 2027 term, starting in January. Reporting to [manager name, title], you will build and improve software that runs on, controls, or supports our industrial 3D printers. You will work close to the hardware, alongside mechanical and electrical engineers, and see your code run on real machines. We give preference to students in their final year of study, and we also welcome candidates who bring exceptional hands-on 3D printing experience.   

 What You Will Do   

• Develop features and fixes in AON3D software, from design through code review and testing.   

• Build internal tools and scripts that automate testing, data collection, and lab workflows.   

• Write and maintain automated tests for the code you work on.   

• Investigate and debug issues that span software and hardware, working with the engineering team.   

• Work with the mechanical and electrical teams to integrate software with new hardware.   

• Document your work so the team can maintain and build on it.   

• Present your results and recommendations to the engineering team.   
 
 What We Are Looking For   

• Currently enrolled in a bachelor's degree in software engineering, computer science, computer engineering, or a related field; final-year students are preferred.   

• Candidates outside that profile are welcome to apply if they can show exceptional hands-on 3D printing experience, such as printer builds, firmware or slicer work, or documented projects.   

• Solid programming skills in at least one language used in production (e.g., Python, C++).   

• Good grasp of fundamentals: data structures, debugging, and testing.   

• Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.   

• Comfort working in Linux environments is an asset.   

• Experience with 3D printing software, such as slicers, G-code, or printer firmware, is a strong asset.   

• Interest in working at the boundary between software and physical hardware.   

• Clear communicator who enjoys working across disciplines.   
 
 Location and Work Model   

 Location: Montreal, QC   Work model: On-site   Employment type: Internship 
 Start Your Journey With Us   

 Apply today and join a team that is shaping the future of additive manufacturing through intelligent, high performance technologies. Not quite the right role for you? Feel free to share this posting with someone in your network who may be a great fit.   

 AON3D uses AI supported tools within portions of the hiring process to promote fair, consistent, and objective evaluation. Certain initial screening steps may be automated to help identify qualified candidates. If your application is declined through an automated step, you may request a human review.   

 We are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and able to contribute. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process, please contact   career s @aon3d.com .   

 Equal Opportunity Statement   

 AON3D is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are given consideration regardless of race, religion, colour, gender, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other protected class as provided in applicable employment laws.

Who we are 
 With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility. 
 
 Timeframe:  Summer (May-Aug 2027) 
  
 At Symbotic, Early Career talent plays a meaningful role in helping us reimagine the future of supply chain automation. Through our Internship and Co-op programs, students have the opportunity to contribute to real projects, collaborate with experienced engineers and business leaders, and gain hands-on exposure to the technologies powering our end-to-end robotics and automation solutions. We are looking for curious, motivated students who are excited to solve complex problems, bring new perspectives to cross-functional teams, and see their work make an impact in a fast-moving, innovative environment.   
   
 Along the way, Interns and Co-ops are supported through mentorship, professional development, networking opportunities, and a robust calendar of events designed to help them build community and grow their careers. Symbotic offers transportation and housing benefits for students who meet our relocation requirements.  
   
 Continue reading below to learn more about this exciting opportunity! 

 About the Opportunity 
 Symbotic’s Software Engineering function is a diverse community of skilled engineers who are building innovative technology across the stack. Intern opportunities in our Software function include:  

• Front-end engineers  that develop and enhance desktop, mobile, and web applications, optimizing performance and usability for end-users.   
  
 What you’ll do  
 
• Play a hands-on role as part of an engineering team that works to design, develop, review and test new functionalities.   
• Collaborate with others on an agile/scrum team to build features based on new business requirements.  
• Evolve the current software architecture toward microservices using .NET Core, Kubernetes, RabbitMQ and Redis.    
• Contribute to a distributed architecture built on .NET using multi-threaded and multi-processor concepts.   
• Create visualizations to extract understanding of current state from logs.   
• Develop high quality code and packages following software engineering best practices.  
• Participate in customer facing calls, visits and workshops to educate and support customers on the integration requirements between Symbotic and customer systems.   
• Work with our customer's technical resources to test Symbotic integrations with their systems.    
 What you’ll need  
 
• Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science or related discipline.  
• Strong object-oriented programming skills in C#, Python and C++.  
• Experience with Linux and its commands.  
• Experience with source control (git), software testing frameworks, and CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins).  
• Enjoys learning new technologies, skills, and techniques as well as teaching them to others.  
• Experience with Vitis and Vivaldo is a plus.  
• Containerized development (Kubernetes, Docker, etc.) is a plus.  
• Experience with cross platform .NET core development is a plus.  
• Experience with MS SQL and the SQL language is a plus.   
 Our Environment:  
 
• Up to 10% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations.   
• The employee is responsible for owning a credit card and managing expenses personally to be reimbursed on a bi-weekly basis.
